The '''Kuat Drive Yards' corporate flagship''' was a vessel that served [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|KDY's]] private fleet.<ref name="TMA" />

==Characteristics==
Little is known of the ship, other than its great viewport offered a view behind the vessel itself, unlike those of other KDY-designed warships, like the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class]] and other warships fitted with the standard T-shaped command tower.<ref name="TMA" />

==History==
[[Kuat (person)|Kuat]] of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] used this ship as his personal [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] on a mission to [[Bombing of the Dune Sea|bomb]] the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in an attempt at killing the notorious [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="TMA" />
